vernacular_zh: 自我夸耀的没有功劳，自高自大的不能长久。
translation_en: ... he who vaunts himself does not find his merit acknowledged; he who is self-conceited has no superiority allowed to him.

scripture.text_zh: 凡自高的，必降为卑；自卑的，必升为高。
scripture.text_en: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

insight_zh: 老子：自夸自大，**无功不长**；耶稣：自卑的人，**必升为高**。
insight_en: Laozi: who vaunts himself **wins no merit**. Jesus: the humble **shall be exalted**.
